scientific_question: Can one minimal reported-geometry risk model per calibration-by-complete-field outer fold choose one five-camera subset that is shared across all four held-out times, while preserving the equal-cost H1-K0 matched-accuracy result and defeating all frozen cheap controls?
role: post-open minimal shared-selector diagnostic on nine opened reconstructed fields, thirteen opened calibrations, and four opened times; not fresh external evidence, not resource evidence, and not real BOST
physical_hypothesis: If the v174 selector-only headroom reflects a stable geometry-to-conditioning relation rather than field/time-specific output switching, one single-output Gram-ridge ranker fitted without the held-out calibration or complete field should choose a time-invariant five-camera subset that remains safe at every held-out time.

inputs.scope_boundary: all fields, calibrations, times, candidate outcomes, and v174 results are already opened; v175 adds a stricter single-output outer-fold model and cannot be called fresh or external

outer_split.heldout_rule: no candidate metric from the held-out calibration or held-out field model enters the fit target, feature normalization, ridge solve, static control, tie break, fallback, or stop decision
outer_split.time_sharing_rule: the fold emits exactly one subset and that immutable subset is used for all four held-out times
outer_split.prediction_input: reported geometry only; this is a strict subset of the deployment-visible observation/geometry contract; model identity, time, observation, density, and held-out outcomes are forbidden at inference

strict_fit_target.definition: for each fit calibration and candidate, log of the maximum normalized metric over the eight fit field models, all four fit times, and three frozen metrics

primary_selector.name: Minimal LOCO-LOMO Shared Gram-Ridge Risk Ranker
primary_selector.geometry_feature: independently validated 356-dimensional H1-whitened world-DCT Gram feature
primary_selector.model: one shared scalar linear ridge regressor with unpenalized intercept per outer fold
primary_selector.feature_standardization: fit calibrations only; population standard deviation and 1e-12 active-column floor
primary_selector.selection: minimum predicted log risk among 126 candidates; exact ties choose the lowest lexicographic subset index

cheap_controls.fit_static: within each calibration-by-field fold, choose one subset minimizing worst then mean fit risk over the twelve fit calibrations
cheap_controls.v169_low_mode_d_opt: frozen result-blind low-frequency geometry selector repeated over every field and time
cheap_controls.ray_axis_maximin: frozen result-free world-ray-axis maximin selector repeated over every field and time
cheap_controls.control_rule: any control passing the identical 468-cell, complete-calibration, complete-field, four-time absolute and own-reference matched gates blocks a minimal-selector advantage claim

reconstruction_contract.candidate: same exact-adjoint DCT1023 H1 fixed-0.03 initializer at K0 for every policy
reconstruction_contract.reference: same selected subset with Zero-CGLS K4 for every policy
reconstruction_contract.h1_penalty: sum of squared physical DCT frequencies normalized by its positive median

exact_call_ledger.geometry_cache: DCT basis projections, subset Grams, generalized spectra, and ray-axis scores are setup costs reported separately from logical online calls
exact_call_ledger.offline_truth_observation: one forward per unique scored subset and field-time cell is data construction only and cannot be counted as deployment speed evidence

matched_reference_gate.scope: each policy candidate is compared only with Zero-CGLS K4 on its own selected observation coordinates

independent_recomputation.features: use independently reconstructed v171 geometry features
independent_recomputation.targets: rebuild all 117 fit targets from independently reconstructed v170 candidate metrics
independent_recomputation.ridge_solver: augmented least-squares rather than formal normal equations
independent_recomputation.operator: independent sparse row builder and bincount forward/adjoint
independent_recomputation.dct_basis: analytic tensor-product cosine basis rather than formal scipy idct basis
required_checks: 117 fold targets exclude held-out calibration and complete field
one selection shared across all four times
468 cells per arm and 3744 total rows
primary candidate and reference physical fields and residuals
three physical metrics and all calibration/field/time tails
each policy absolute and own-reference matched gates

decision_order: Any input, parent, fold-isolation, prediction, mutation, operator, solve, call-accounting, numeric, seal, or independent-recomputation failure makes v175 inconclusive.

If the minimal shared selector fails any strict held-out cell, whole calibration, whole field model, time stratum, or own-reference matched gate, conclude FAIL_MINIMAL_SHARED_SELECTOR_PARITY_V175 and close this single-output Gram-ridge selector.

If the primary passes but any fit-static, v169 low-mode D-opt, or ray-axis maximin control also passes, conclude FAIL_CHEAP_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_MINIMAL_SHARED_SELECTOR_V175 and do not claim selector advantage.
Only if the primary passes every gate, all three controls fail, exact-call receipts agree, and independent recomputation passes may v175 conclude PASS_MINIMAL_SHARED_SELECTOR_HEADROOM_V175.
A pass is only opened-development evidence for a minimal CPU selector. It is not external generalization, resource speedup, algorithm breakthrough, paper success, curved-ray validation, or real BOST.
